visual_review.method: All 48 consecutive-frame atlases opened and visually inspected. Each cell is 384x216; this is not full-resolution inspection of every frame.

observations.finding: Opening line follow and close detail, enamel falloff, pins snap around four seconds.
Magnets hold a physical bridge/ship setup; verdict stamp lands at frame 193 before a hold.
Rule writing, removed magnets, falling ruler, then a fast downward move around 348.
Beam detail opens into a measured judgment; blue dimension precedes red shortfall; arch enters near 448.
Arch dimension draws across frames 480–486, label settles 490–499, red shortfall extends 511–524; then hold.
Downward zoom and detail of cable bridge, then pullback by 576; dimension draws from 583 onward.
Dimension completes around 611; 1208 and qualification labels land 618–630. A long legible hold follows.
Subtitles fade; staircase camera moves down at 679 and settles on the next bridge by 695, then pulls back through 714.
Final bridge measurement grows, 2023 caption and label land 728–739, red circle appears 752–756. Hold before final claim.
Camera follows the passing ship under the suspension bridge, with temporal blur confined to movement.
Ship continues across; large pullback begins around 860. Whole-board composition arrives around 894.
Last headline writes in place through 912, then the full board and tray hold to the end.

comparison_rule: Pair by visual function, not pixel identity between different stories. Review the final encoded film separately.
